design_rule: This is an aggregate/domain-extension contract over CGX-IR Universal Cells. It does not create a second canonical object store or replace topology/DBR.

identity.object_id: stable cryptographic/logical identity; never inferred solely from filename or display name
identity.type_id: domain registry type; extensible through reviewed registries/CCC packages
identity.domain_id: owning semantic domain, not necessarily storage/provider location
identity.source_identity: native provider/file/workbook/CAD identity retained independently of object identity

inheritance.authority: never inherited implicitly across object/domain boundaries
inheritance.evidence: never inherited as proof; only explicit evidence relations count
inheritance.defaults: type/library defaults may be inherited but materialised object overrides are explicit
inheritance.lifecycle: object-specific; parent archival does not silently archive independently owned children
inheritance.view_hints: may inherit as presentation defaults only

mutation.representation_change: does not mutate semantics unless an accepted semantic delta returns
mutation.session_view_state: Host-local/noncanonical unless explicitly saved as a portable lens profile

validation_rules: confidence values must be finite numbers within declared bounds; NaN/Infinity are invalid
units/basis required for dimensional numerical values unless explicitly dimensionless
source/evidence must retain native identity and revision/hash when available
configuration-sensitive facts must carry configuration/state qualifier
time-sensitive observations must carry time/state reference
unknown or contradictory state must not be coerced into a single resolved value
provider location never establishes semantic authority
a generated view/export cannot become source authority by existence
